lines.speaker: BARB JANDA:
lines.text: mh huh. What did he do to you to make you do it?

lines.text: Did he force you to do it? (Brendan shakes head "no")

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER ON THE PHONE:
lines.text: All right if, if we go in tomorrow and I think we need someone, I'll call you. All right?

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA:
lines.text: Ohh. (door opens and closes) Are you regrettin' it now? (pause) You had a whole life ahead of you Brendan. Just because he's so demanding, doesn't mean you gotta do the stuff he says. Right?

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA:
lines.text: Where do you think you're going?

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA:
lines.text: You're goin' to juvie, that's where you're going, to a juvie jail. About 45 minutes away.
